changes: 📖 New: Syndy's Book — peer prediction markets. Stake XP on YES/NO questions about the group; when a market resolves, the losing side's whole pool splits across the winners, proportional to stake — the effective payout genuinely shifts as more XP piles onto one side, the same way a real parimutuel book works. Admin creates and resolves markets from the Casino tab; everyone can stake.

🎤 New: Syndy Voice — a spoken reaction, out loud, the instant you land a genuinely big win. Uses the browser's own built-in text-to-speech (free, no new cost or API key) — worth knowing the voice quality/character depends entirely on your own device/browser, not a custom AI voice. Toggle in the Casino hub if it's not your thing.
